mealAnalysis.guidance_message: This appears to be a mixed green salad with tomato, a low-calorie meal that is relatively low in simple carbohydrates and generally has a mild effect on blood sugar levels for someone with diabetes. It is best to choose a light dressing and maintain this meal pattern, opting for whole grain additions or other high-fiber ingredients instead of refined carbohydrate sides if more energy is needed.
mealAnalysis.meal_description: A simple salad made with leafy greens and chopped tomato, with no clearly visible high-calorie toppings or refined carbohydrate components.
